fluxer.js.instance-Comment: Using a self-hosted Fluxer instance? Add an 'instance' object here with your domain's URLs (api, gateway, media, ...). See README -> Self-hosted Fluxer instance. Leave it out to use the official fluxer.app.

voiceCommands.Comment: Voice commands: the bot listens in the voice channel and runs commands said after the wake word (e.g. 'DJ, skip'). Needs the whisper container: docker compose --profile voice up -d. The Whisper models are English-only, so use English command names.

donate.Comment: Link shown by %donate and the Donate button in the web panel. The bot stays free; donations unlock nothing. Set enabled to false to hide it, or put your own link in url.

invite.Comment: Optional. %invite builds the add-to-server link automatically (your Fluxer web app + the bot ID + the needed permissions). Set url to replace the whole link, or clientId / permissions to override just those parts.

web.Comment: Built-in web control panel (player, queue, search, settings, status, logs). Disabled until you set a password. language: 'en' (default) or 'ro' for a Romanian panel. Served on port 8080 inside the container (8090 on the host by default).

oauth.Comment: Optional Login with Fluxer for server managers (they only see servers where they have Manage Server). Needs HTTPS, the application client secret and the redirect URI <panel address>/api/oauth/callback registered on Fluxer.
